		cancel_trigger = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active } NOT = { has_socialist_government = yes } } } }
		modifier = {
		political_power_cost = -0.025
	}
		complete_effect = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_edu_listen_progress_tt
		hidden_effect = { RUS_education_begin_listen = yes }
	}
		cancel_effect = { hidden_effect = { RUS_education_cancel_listen = yes } }
		remove_effect = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_edu_listen_finish_tt
		effect_tooltip = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_edu_result_listen } }
		hidden_effect = { RUS_education_finish_listen = yes }
	}
		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}
	RUS_education_restore_order = {
		icon = GFX_decision_generic_research
		fire_only_once = no
		cost = RUS_edu_cost_restore_order?20
		days_remove = 30
		days_re_enable = 60
		visible = {
		has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active
	}
		available = {
		hidden_trigger = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active has_socialist_government = yes }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = RUS_edu_control_free_tt NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_control_busy } }
		NOT = { check_variable = { RUS_education_enthusiasm < 70 } }
		custom_trigger_tooltip = { tooltip = RUS_edu_cooldown_tt NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_edu_cooldown_restore_order } }
	}
		cancel_trigger = { hidden_trigger = { OR = { NOT = { has_country_flag = RUS_education_system_active } NOT = { has_socialist_government = yes } } } }
		modifier = {
		political_power_cost = -0.025
	}
		complete_effect = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_edu_restore_order_progress_tt
		hidden_effect = { RUS_education_begin_restore_order = yes }
	}
		cancel_effect = { hidden_effect = { RUS_education_cancel_restore_order = yes } }
		remove_effect = {
		custom_effect_tooltip = RUS_edu_restore_order_finish_tt
		effect_tooltip = { add_dynamic_modifier = { modifier = RUS_edu_result_restore_order } }
		hidden_effect = { RUS_education_finish_restore_order = yes }
	}
		ai_will_do = { base = 1 }
	}
